instruction:
Prepare DRC settings in the real Altium native board file `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc` instead of generating an external fix log. Save the modified native document as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_drc_prep.PcbDoc` in Altium Designer.

Requirements:
- Change `REPORTFILENAME` to `wifi_drc.rpt`.
- Change `MAXVIOLATIONCOUNT` to `5`.
- Change `CLEARANCE` of rule `PlaneClearance` to `6mil`.
- Change both `GAP` and `VERTICALGAP` of rule `ComponentClearance` to `12mil`.

This task evaluates native DRC-rule and report-setting preparation, not simulating the result with Python.
source: Local Altium example `Mini PC - WiFi/WiFi.PcbDoc`; benchmark task materially redesigned from a text-only DRC-loop simulation to native DRC configuration editing.
